en: Improved the `/` menu, `/skills`, `/context` and the `/plugin` Installed list to show skills synced from claude.ai by their short name when no other command uses it, not `anthropic-skills:<name>`
zh: 改进 `/` 菜单、`/skills`、`/context` 和 `/plugin` 的已安装列表：从 claude.ai 同步的 skill 在没有其他命令占用其短名时，以短名显示，而非 `anthropic-skills:<name>`
